'''Zel''' is a male student NPC seen trying to study at [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Spacetrek Archive]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Zel:''' "Analysis on Multidimensional Consciousness Mapping," haven't read it. "Foundations of Neuro-Resonance Topology," haven't read it. "Principles of Exostrider Archaeo Semiotics," no idea, also haven't read it.
:'''Zel:''' "Intro to Threshold-Stress Psychology," understandable. Two chapters left. "World Culture Essentials," low credit weight, skipping it.
:'''Zel:''' The Voidmatter Environment Simulation class... Well, cross that bridge when I get there.
:'''Zel:''' Ugh, and I still have to submit the cultivation results of the "Crystalized Energy Core" ...Eugh, why does Rabelle College make us study everything? Why is school so hard...?
:'''Zel:''' ...Oh? This Tropical Pine-Needle Soda from the Agronomy Wing is actually pretty good.
:'''Zel:''' Food first. Then I'll watch a Peaks of Prestige match. There are so many textbooks and not a single worked example... If I don't understand it now, I definitely won't during the exam...
:'''Zel:''' And honestly? Studying while watching matches is kind of efficient... Is this what they call a positive feedback loop?
{{Dialogue End}}
